problem_type: Declaration wire field names drift from the upstream contract
symptom: Suno Sounds sends sound_type/sound_tempo/sound_key instead of type/bpm/key.
direct_cause: Canonical parameter keys were copied as JSON property names.
class_root: Wire keys were not checked against independent official endpoint field contracts.
affected_population: Existing Suno Sounds nodes and every newly declared version
Other audio endpoint templates added from canonical controls

external_sources.purpose: Allowed JSON fields and ranges for every sounds version.
Current text declarations share the existing Chat request and response boundary.
Exact text IDs and conservative current token prices.

invariants: Canonical saved controls remain stable; wire property names follow the endpoint contract.
All versions share one typed sounds body and the common endpoint class test.

door_reduction.why_not: The catalog declarations, shared seed reconciliation, health inventory, identity normalization and design projection are existing distinct readers; their public shapes are unchanged.

generality_proof: All sounds versions use the same constrained body declaration; independent field fixtures check music, sounds, TTS and Lyria and a non-Suno mutation proves the class check rejects drift.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Single typed wire body for saved and current sounds versions.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Their wire fields match independently fetched official contracts and are checked by the same field-set test.

recurrence.reason: A new version or endpoint can repeat a canonical/wire naming mismatch.
same_class_scan: Inspected TTS_CREATE, Lyria and kieSunoAudio declarations; canonical and wire names have different owners.

prevention.invariant: Every Suno sounds version has only official JSON keys.
prevention.failure_mode: Typed declaration rejects wrong keys at compile time and endpoint contract matrix fails validation.
prevention.strategy: Reuse one constrained wire body; preserve stored canonical controls.

legacy_paths.rationale: Removed old sound_* wire properties; canonical controls remain compatible.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Plain declaration data; no third-party runtime change.

migration: Same existing model key and mapping id reconcile in place with corrected wire properties; new V6 keys never overwrite saved nodes.
residual_risks: Official V6 endpoints do not enumerate V5.5 support; retained legacy requests require coordinator live verification.
Only first audio result is consumed by existing D operation.

invariant_owner_layer.why: The declaration owns wire property names; the shared request builder only renders them.
